summary: Frontend-only test of new '/info' Info & FAQ page and its CMS editor at /admin (Info & FAQ tab). Public page: eyebrow 'BEFORE YOU RIDE', h1 'Know before you go.', intro paragraphs, and 14 numbered category accordions all render. Category-level accordion (aria-expanded toggles false<->true), question-level accordion (33 total questions), RichText answers, Open all (14 cats + 33 qs = all expanded), Close all (0 expanded), Contact section with WhatsApp (wa.me/919810732107), Email (mailto:info@7huesexpeditions.com), Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/7huesexpeditions/) links, single italic closing line, and Footer all present. CMS: /admin loads with 'Info & FAQ' sidebar tab (data-testid=admin-tab-infofaq); editor shows Eyebrow/Heading/Intro inputs, 'FAQ Categories' list editor, nested 'Questions' editor per category (Question + Answer + Visible toggle), and 'Closing contact section'. End-to-end save persistence VERIFIED twice: (1) changed Heading to 'Know before you go. (TEST)' -> Save -> reload /info -> heading updated -> reverted; (2) toggled category 'THE EXPEDITION' Visible->Hidden -> Save -> reload /info -> category count dropped from 14 to 13 and 'THE EXPEDITION' absent -> reverted. Data reverted to original state at end. No regressions found.
critical_code_review_comments: InfoFAQ.js filter chain removes categories with zero visible questions (line 78 `.filter((c) => c.questions.length > 0)`). If an admin hides all questions in a category, the category silently disappears from the public page even if its Visible toggle is on — worth documenting or surfacing a warning in the CMS.

CMS 'Add category' blank uses `title: 'NEW CATEGORY'` and Add question uses empty string `q: ''` — empty questions will still render on the public page as an empty tappable row until answered. Consider hiding questions with empty q/a from public output.

Contact WhatsApp label filters via `(settings.whatsapp || '').replace(/[^\d]/g, '')` — if the admin removes WhatsApp from settings, the button disappears. This is intended behavior but not obvious to CMS editor (mentioned in helper text). Fine as-is.

InfoFAQ initial state `useState(() => new Set([0]))` always opens the first category by default — nice UX, but note if the first category is Hidden, the second category (index 0 in the filtered list) is what opens, which is the intended behavior via filtered array — confirmed working.
